name: aizen-skill-creator
description: Create or improve Aizen skills to the Aizen standard, with docs, evals and npm test

steps.hint: the confirmed design note, saved under the run's work/ folder
aizen-skill-eval review.md (waive for a pure reference pack)

expectations.text: The skill does what the confirmed design note says, and nothing the note left out
The description has what · 'Use when …' with real trigger words · 'Not for: …' naming the owning skills
Repeatable logic lives in scripts with --help and --selfcheck; SKILL.md is imperative and lean
Nothing aizen-core already says is repeated — it is linked
